findings.summary: Not run: `pnpm exec playwright test tests/e2e/report.spec.ts tests/e2e/history.spec.ts`. Capability-level check outside this unit's Done when; needs a built UI and ReportOptions.tsx / ComparePage.tsx, which are outside this unit's files. Deferred to integration (see messages[]).

Not run: the evolution-PDF case of forbiddenTerms.test.ts. The file is outside this unit's allowed files. Deferred to integration; the unit's own forbidden-term check (evolutionDocument.test.ts) passes.

The diary half of 'O que foi feito no período' (custo por cliente do diário) is built and unit-tested in evolutionDocument.ts (EvolutionPeriod.diary), but reportService.prepareEvolution passes no diary because the diary storage only arrives in phase-4-backend-diary-api. AC-ra-12 is therefore only partly delivered for the period page until Phase 4 passes period.diary. Not a failure of this unit: its Done when does not cover the diary.

AC-ra-12 says 'estágio antes → depois'. The document writes 'antes para depois' ('2 para 3', 'R$ ... para R$ ...') because the implementer reports the PDF fonts lack U+2192 and the arrow would be dropped. The font check is implementer-reported and was not re-verified here. Owner should accept the wording deviation or ask for a font with the glyph.

'Antes e depois' spans three sheets (summary, 'Encaixes do negócio' bars, 'Frentes de crescimento' bars) instead of one. Reason given: 16 paired bars do not fit one A4 at the existing dimensionBars size. Page ids before-after, before-after-fit, before-after-front. Acceptable per the AC wording; flagged for the owner.

Lines 169 and 194 hard-code rulesV1.dimensionSupport.warnBelow for the bar threshold text, while the belowWarning flags come from the rules passed in (shared/domain/dimensionScores.ts:80). No live defect: rulesV1 and the rulesV2 fixture share warnBelow = 50. Would diverge if a future rules version changed warnBelow. Same pattern in server/report/reportModel.ts:335, outside this unit.

messages.text: Run the capability-level checks after the frontend and phase 4 land: `pnpm exec playwright test tests/e2e/report.spec.ts tests/e2e/history.spec.ts` (AC-ra-12 interaction report-type-evolution; AC-ra-14 'Até' only offers later diagnoses). Steps: start the app with the Play-injected PORT (or the dev preview), build the UI, then run the command from the repo root; record the exit code.
Add the evolution PDF case to tests/unit/forbiddenTerms.test.ts (run `pnpm exec vitest run tests/unit/forbiddenTerms.test.ts`).

server/app.ts builds createReportService without `rules`; the service defaults to rulesV1 (same as app rules today). Pass `rules` there (one line) so a custom rules object also reaches the evolution recalculation. Not changed here: app.ts is owned by phase-3-backend-actions-api.

AC-ra-13 holds by construction only if src/features/history/ComparePage.tsx imports DELTA_WORDS, STAGE_MOVES, formatDelta, formatComparisonMonth and recalculationNotice from shared/content/comparisonCopy.ts. ReportOptions must offer De/Até (Até only later diagnoses, AC-ra-14) and send kind 'evolution' with fromId/toId. QA did not verify the frontend side (outside this unit).

When the diary exists, pass its months of the period as period.diary (DiaryChartPoint[], oldest first) into prepareEvolution in server/services/reportService.ts. Until then the AC-ra-12 diary half is absent and the period page shows only tracked actions.

Owner decision points (not failures): (a) 'para' used instead of the AC's '→' because the PDF fonts have no U+2192 glyph; (b) 'Antes e depois' is three sheets, not one. Both are reported as low contract deviations.
